gold_assessment.reasoning: Gold: acute onset left-sided chest discomfort/pressure. Generated cc-001: chief complaint is chest discomfort. Side and acuity omitted but core complaint of chest discomfort is present.

Gold: pressure sensation like someone sitting on his chest, 7/10. Generated hpi-003: pressure, not typical pain, like someone sitting on the chest; hpi-004: severity 7/10. Combined they fully capture the gold fact.
Gold: radiates to the left shoulder and arm. Generated hpi-005 only mentions radiation to the left shoulder; left arm radiation is missing.
Gold: episode lasted 1–2 hours so far. Generated hpi-001: onset a couple of hours ago. This is an equivalent description of 1–2 hours in duration.

Gold: first episode started while gardening. Generated hpi-001: chest discomfort began a couple of hours ago while gardening; hpi-008: chest discomfort occurred in the context of gardening. Both convey onset during gardening; 'first presentation' is implied but not explicitly stated.
Gold: no radiation to the head. None of the generated facts address radiation to the head.
Gold: nausea without vomiting since presentation. Generated hpi-006: includes nausea; ros-001: no vomiting yet. Together they match the gold fact.

Gold: shortness of breath at rest. Generated hpi-006: associated symptoms include shortness of breath; does not explicitly say 'at rest' but does not conflict. Considered covered at a less specific level.

Gold: longer-term reduced ADLs due to shortness of breath on exertion. Generated hpi-007: difficulty climbing stairs, walking uphill, and limited daily activity due to exertional intolerance. This matches the longer-term exertional dyspnea limiting ADLs.

Gold: previously could walk up hills and stairs without chest discomfort. Generated hpi-007: now has difficulty climbing stairs and walking uphill; implies prior better tolerance. This reflects the same concept of reduced exertional capacity compared with prior.
Gold: history of high cholesterol/hyperlipidemia. Generated pmh-002: history of hyperlipidemia. Direct match.
Gold: history of high blood pressure. Generated pmh-001: history of hypertension. Direct match.
Gold: allergic to aspirin. Generated allergy-001: allergic to aspirin. Direct match.
Gold: lives at home with his wife. Generated sh-001: lives at home with his wife. Direct match.

Gold: previously able to walk up stairs without difficulty. Generated hpi-007 and assessment asm-003 describe prior functional status now limited; this reflects decreased exertional tolerance, consistent with the gold fact about prior stair-climbing ability.
Gold: differential includes MI. None of the generated Assessment or Plan facts explicitly list MI in the differential.
Gold: differential includes PE. No generated fact names pulmonary embolism as a differential.
Gold: differential includes GORD. No generated fact names gastro-oesophageal reflux disease or GERD/GORD.

Gold: ambulance called for suspected MI and further investigation and assessment. Generated plan-001: EMS to ED for acute chest pain workup (ECG, troponin, labs, imaging, vitals). This reflects ambulance transport to ED for suspected serious cardiac etiology and further investigation, though 'suspected MI' wording is not explicit.

Matches description of pressure 'like someone sitting on his chest'; the note that it is 'not typical pain' is additional nuance but not contradictory.
Gold gives intensity 7/10; generated states 7/10 at worst and currently similar. This is consistent and slightly more detailed.
Gold: radiates to the left shoulder and arm. Generated: radiates to the left shoulder. This is a partial capture of the gold fact and does not contradict it.

Gold: longer-term reduced ADLs due to shortness of breath on exertion. Generated: difficulty climbing stairs/walking uphill, limited daily activity due to exertional intolerance, which is aligned.
Gold mentions first episode started while gardening but does not state that the patient is normally fit or has a 'fortnightly gardening cadence.' Those contextual details are new.
Calf pain and leg swelling are not mentioned anywhere in the gold facts; entirely new information.

Hypertension = high blood pressure. Directly matches gold past medical history.
